reviews.title: Dead after only a couple of days
reviews.comment: My laptop could not recognize it the first few times I plugged it in. Finally it was recognized and I cloned my harddrive on it. I was able to get my laptop to recognize it one more time, but that was it. No matter what cord I use and/or computer I use, it will not work. I even tried plugging it directly into the main harddrive slot. Still, it would not recognize it. Now I have a worthless harddrive after just a few days, and I can't return it because I recorded personal financial files on it, and there still could be some chance that it could decide to work one more time. I'm not a fan.
reviews.author: J. W. Becton
